name: Cycles & Brew Coffee Run & Rave 2027
short_description: Cycles & Brew Coffee Run & Rave 2027 is on Sunday 24 January 2027 at Filinvest Mimosa+ in Clark, with a 21 km half marathon at 5am, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km and a dog run.
ai_summary: The Cycles & Brew Coffee Run & Rave 2027 is a coffee-themed road race on Sunday 24 January 2027 at Filinvest Mimosa+ Leisure City in the Clark Freeport Zone, Pampanga. Its distances are named after coffees, from the 21 km Long Black half marathon, which starts at 5am with a cut-off of 3 hours 30 minutes, to a 1 km Dogoccino dog run, and a post-race rave follows. It is run by GoRacePH, with entries on Race Roster from PHP 899 to 1,899.

core_facts.venue: Filinvest Mimosa+ Leisure City, Clark Freeport Zone

faqs.question: When is the Cycles & Brew Coffee Run & Rave 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 24 January 2027. The 21 km assembles at 4.30am and starts at 5am with a cut-off of 3 hours 30 minutes; the 10 km starts at 6.15am (two hours), the 5 km at 6.45am (one hour), the 3 km at 7am and the dog run at 7.30am. The organiser expects sunrise at 6.25am.

faqs.question: What distances are there and what do they cost?
faqs.answer: Five, named after coffees: Long Black 21 km (PHP 1,899), Latte 10 km (PHP 1,699), Cortado 5 km (PHP 999), Espresso 3 km (PHP 899) and the Dogoccino 1 km dog run (PHP 1,199), which needs a vaccination certificate. Race Roster fees are added. The 21 km and 10 km include a finisher medal, finisher shirt and coffee vouchers.

faqs.question: Are there age-group awards?
faqs.answer: Yes. Overall champions are recognised, and the 21 km awards top-three medals by gender in the 18-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59 and 60-and-over age groups, with age counted as 2027 minus birth year. The 2026 edition was held at the same Filinvest Mimosa venue in January 2026.
